description.zh:
Custom for SQL Server批量查询指定资源的监控数据。
格式：`key:value`键值对形式的集合。
description.en:
Custom for SQL Server to batch query monitoring data for specified resources.  
Format: a collection of key:value pairs.

description.zh: 查询结束时间，格式如：`2024-08-06 10:15:00`，必须大于查询开始时间。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Example: `2024-08-06 10:15:00`.

description.zh:
每页显示的记录条数，用于分页查询。

默认值：1000。
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

Default value: 1000.

>  The maximum value of the Length parameter in a request is 1440.
The metric that you want to use. For more information, see [CloudMonitor metrics](https://cms.console.aliyun.com/metric-meta/acs_ecs_dashboard/ecs).

description.zh:
监控数据的统计周期（单位：秒），取值：

- 60（默认值）
- 60的整数倍
description.en:
The statistical period of the monitoring data.

Set the value to 60 or an integer multiple of 60.

Unit: seconds.

Default value: 60.
The beginning of the time range to query. Example: `2024-08-06 10:05:00`.

title.zh: 查看RDS Custom实例的监控数据
title.en: View Monitoring Data of an RDS Custom Instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds describe-rc-metric-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --metric-name CPUUtilization --express None --end-time 2024-08-06_10:15:00 --next-token 6178f1825f9fb76ce0b5e8707e000000 --length 1000 --start-time 2024-08-06_10:05:00 --period 60 --instance-id rc-dh2jf9n6j4s149260000 --dimensions instanceId_:_rc-l9hv3rv74ql7oa000000_,_instanceId_:_rc-b532l1uj8n6sex000000 --region cn-hangzhou
